articles.title: FingerMotion, Inc. Announces Corporate Name Change to BlueFlare, Inc. and Nasdaq Ticker Symbol Change to "BFLR”
articles.description: Changes Effective at Market Open on November 25, 2026 WEST PALM BEACH, Fla. and CALGARY, Alberta, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FingerMotion, Inc. (Nasdaq: FNGR) ("FingerMotion” or the "Company”) today announced that it has changed its corporate name to BlueFlare, Inc. and that its common stock will begin trading on the Nasdaq Stock Market under the new ticker symbol "BFLR,” effective at the open of trading on November 25, 2026. The name and symbol changes reflect the Company’s strategic transformation into a pure-play North American infrastructure business focused on delivering firm, behind-the-meter power and modular high-performance computing capacity. The changes follow the Company’s previously announced proposed business combination with BlueFlare Group Holdings Inc. (now BlueFlare Canada Inc.), a Calgary-based developer of behind-the-meter power generation and modular high-performance computing infrastructure. Beginning November 25, 2026, the Company’s common stock will trade on Nasdaq under the symbol "BFLR.” No action is required by existing stockholders. Outstanding stock certificates and the Company’s CUSIP number remain unchanged. Stockholders’ shares will automatically convert to the new trading symbol in brokerage accounts. "This name and symbol change marks the completion of FingerMotion’s deliberate pivot to a North American power-first digital infrastructure company,” said Jolie Kahn, Chief Executive Officer of the Company. "BlueFlare, Inc. is built to deliver firm power and computing-ready capacity on timelines enterprises can plan around. We are enthusiastic to move forward under a name and ticker that clearly reflect our strategy and our future.” "BlueFlare is a power-first company. We own the generation, we self-perform the build, and we operate the sites. Today’s name and ticker change give the market a clear view of who we are and what we deliver,” said Landon Ruszkowski, President and Chief Executive Officer of BlueFlare Canada Inc. Polimeni continuing as Chief Financial Officer. Headquarters of the BlueFlare platform remain in Calgary, Alberta. About BlueFlare, Inc. BlueFlare, Inc. BlueFlare Canada Inc. self-performs design, engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning and operations of natural-gas-powered computing campuses, primarily in Alberta, Canada. articles.title: Youxin Technology Ltd Announces 1-for-6 Share Consolidation
articles.description: Guangzhou, China, Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Youxin Technology Ltd (Nasdaq: YAAS) ("Youxin Technology” or the "Company”), a software as a service ("SaaS”) and platform as a service ("PaaS”) provider committed to helping retail enterprises digitally transform their businesses, today announced that, at the Company’s annual general meeting, the Company’s shareholders have approved, by ordinary resolution, authorizing the Company’s board of directors to conduct a share consolidation of the Company’s Class A ordinary shares at a ratio of one-for-six, with an expected market effective date of November 27, 2026. The objective of the share consolidation is to increase the per-share trading price of the Company’s Class A ordinary shares and provide the Company with greater flexibility to support the continued listing and marketability of its securities. Beginning with the opening of trading on November 27, 2026, the Company’s Class A ordinary shares will trade on the Nasdaq Capital Market on a split-adjusted basis, under the same symbol "YAAS” but under a new CUSIP number, G9876W146. The share consolidation will reduce the number of the Company’s Class A ordinary shares issued and outstanding from approximately 6,769,352 to approximately 1,128,226 (subject to adjustment due to the effect of rounding up fractional shares into whole shares). The authorized number of Class A ordinary shares will be reduced by the same ratio, from 163,800,000,000 to 27,300,000,000, and the par value of each Class A ordinary share will increase from US$0.04 to US$0.24. The Company’s Class B ordinary shares are not being consolidated and are not affected by the share consolidation. The number of Class A ordinary shares issuable upon exercise of the Company’s outstanding warrants and equity awards, and the applicable exercise prices, will be proportionately adjusted in accordance with their respective terms. As a result of the share consolidation, each six pre-split ordinary shares outstanding will automatically combine and convert to one issued and outstanding Class A ordinary share without any action on the part of the shareholder. No fractional ordinary shares will be issued to any shareholders in connection with the share consolidation. The total number of Class A ordinary shares to be received by each shareholder will be rounded up to the next whole Class A ordinary share that would have resulted from the share consolidation. About Youxin Technology Ltd Youxin Technology Ltd is a SaaS and PaaS provider committed to helping retail enterprises digitally transform their businesses through its cloud-based SaaS product and PaaS platform. The Company provides customized, comprehensive and fast-deployment omnichannel digital solutions to its customers. For more information, please visit the Company’s website: https://ir.youxin.cloud. articles.title: MindWave Innovations Inc., a subsidiary of Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US (NYSE American: APUS) Powers Over $25 Million USD in Insured ALCI Ecosystem Credits, Launched at UN Climate Conference COP31
articles.description: Credits are issued and managed on AQUAEChain, built on MindWave’s MindChain, a fully insured Layer 2 blockchain, with insurance coverage provided through Lloyd’s syndicate partners MATAWAN, N.J., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- via IBN - Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. (NYSE American: APUS) ("Apimeds” or the "Company”) today announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, MindWave Innovations Inc. ("MindWave”), is powering over $25 million USD in fully insured ecosystem credits issued under the AQUAE Labs Ecosystems Conservation Index (ALCI). The credits were launched at COP31, the United Nations Climate Change Conference held in Antalya, Türkiye, from November 11 to 20, 2026. COP31 convened under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), the international environmental treaty established to stabilize greenhouse gas concentrations and mitigate human-induced climate disruptions that threaten the global environmental stability of our climate system. The ALCI credits are issued and managed on AQUAEChain, an institutional-grade platform that MindWave built and operates on MindChain, its Ethereum-anchored Layer 2 blockchain. Insurance coverage for the credits is provided through Lloyd’s syndicate partners. The launch follows MindWave’s agreement with AQUAE Holdings Pte. Ltd. ("AQUAE Labs”) in September 2026 to build and operate AQUAEChain. MindChain: Insured Infrastructure for Real-World Assets MindChain is developed and operated by MindWave as the world’s first fully insured Layer 2 blockchain anchored to Ethereum. It is built to give institutions the auditability, risk mitigation and transparency they need to hold and trade tokenized real-world assets. On AQUAEChain, MindChain keeps the underlying environmental evidence separate from transaction records. Ecological data stays unchanged and fully traceable as each credit is issued, transferred or retired. This gives auditors a clear trail and removes the risk of the same credit being counted twice. AQUAE Labs’ credit issuance system on AQUAEChain, which links each credit to a verified ecological record, has a patent application pending in Singapore. About the ALCI Credits The AQUAE Labs Ecosystems Conservation Index (ALCI) is a field-based monitoring, recording and verification (MRV) framework. It evaluates the biomass, biodiversity and ecological function of land-based ecosystems, following the approach defined by the IUCN and other repeatable scientific methods. ALCI measures seven areas of ecosystem performance: above-ground biomassoxygen productionwater purificationcoolingsoil water retentionliving soilbiodiversity These measurements inform a transparent valuation of the ecosystem services each credit represents. "MindChain provides the ledger infrastructure behind AQUAEChain, giving each ALCI Credit a verifiable record from issuance to retirement," said Dr. Vin Menon, Chief Executive Officer of MindWave Innovations Inc. USA. "Our role is to deliver the transparency and auditability that buyers and investors in environmental assets expect, and to support AQUAE as the platform grows.” "The launch of ALCI Credits at COP31 was an important step for AQUAE," said Linju Thomas, Chief Operating Officer of AQUAE Labs. "Working with MindWave gives us the infrastructure to issue, track and verify each credit transparently as we expand." By pairing robust, field-based ecological MRV with insurance coverage from Lloyd’s syndicate partners, AQUAE Labs is establishing a new standard of trust, transparency and bankability for non-carbon nature assets. At COP31, the MindWave team held technical infrastructure discussions and met with institutional partners about MindChain, alongside the AQUAE Labs team, which engaged with prospective corporate buyers, institutional investors and implementation partners. About MindWave Innovations Inc. MindWave Innovations Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. (NYSE American: APUS), builds institutional infrastructure for digital finance across digital asset treasury, insurance and tokenized real-world assets. Its MindChain platform is a fully insured, Ethereum-anchored Layer 2 blockchain that hosts dedicated industry networks, including AQUAEChain (ClimateTech), FlashChain (AdTech and media) and AssureChain (InsurTech). Learn more at www.mindwaveinnovations.com. About Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. (NYSE American: APUS) operates through its wholly owned subsidiary, MindWave, which develops enterprise technology infrastructure and builds and operates dedicated networks for clients in climate finance, sports media, insurance and financial services. About AQUAE Labs AQUAE Labs is a Singapore-based company that combines ecological science with artificial intelligence and blockchain technology to measure, verify and value ecosystem services. Its work connects conservation and restoration projects with climate finance. articles.title: Alico, Inc. Announces Financial Results for the Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year Ended September 30, 2026
articles.description: Alico Closes Fiscal Year 2026 with $34.1 million of Land Sales and Approximately 91% of Total Acres Being Leased Net Income Attributable to Alico, Inc. Common Stockholders of $6.6 million and Adjusted EBITDA of $22.1 million for Fiscal Year 2026, Exceeding Guidance of Approximately $15.0 Million Cash and Cash Equivalents of $52.6 million as of September 30, 2026, Extending Cash Runway Through Fiscal Year 2029 Without Requiring Additional Asset Sales Corkscrew Grove Villages Continues to Progress Through State and Federal Permitting Following Local Entitlement Approval FORT MYERS, Fla., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alico, Inc. ("Alico” or the "Company,” "we,” "us” or "our”) (Nasdaq: ALCO) today announced financial results for the fourth quarter and fiscal year ended September 30, 2026. Management Comment John Kiernan, President and Chief Executive Officer of the Company, stated, "Fiscal year 2026 was a year of steady progress with our diversified land strategy. "With our citrus operation wind-down largely behind us, our attention during fiscal year 2026 turned towards optimizing our land portfolio for our shareholders. We realized more than $34.0 million in opportunistic land sales, which also exceeded management's estimates for value. We invested approximately $2.0 million through the acquisition of the portion of Citree that we didn't own to continue to consolidate our ownership of acres within our 20,000 acre Joshua Grove in Arcadia. Our land leasing program to other operators has been rigorous, and now approximately 91% of our total acres are leased for productive use." "Net Income attributable to Alico was $6.6 million for fiscal year 2026 and Adjusted EBITDA was $22.1 million, significantly exceeding our previously announced guidance of approximately $15 million. We ended the year with cash and cash equivalents of $52.6 million, ahead of our guidance of approximately $48 million, net debt of $32.7 million and approximately $92.5 million of available borrowing capacity. We believe that our cash balance creates a competitive liquidity advantage for Alico and that this cash balance will allow us to fund our operations through fiscal year 2029 without requiring additional asset sales and to advance our development pipeline on our own timeline.” "Looking ahead, our mission does not change. We intend to continue to opportunistically sell non-strategic assets. We will build strong relationships with agricultural lessees as appropriate. We intend to seek to maximize lease income on our agricultural acreage for the long-term. We will continue to prioritize entitlement-driven work on our highest value properties with management attention, financial resources, and capital when necessary. Real Estate and Land Development In June 2025, the Florida Legislature established the Corkscrew Grove Stewardship District. Stewardship districts are independent special districts authorized to plan, finance, construct, operate and maintain public infrastructure in planned developments, operating on the principle that growth pays for itself. Similar districts are used in communities like Ave Maria and Lakewood Ranch. In March 2025, the Company announced the creation of Corkscrew Grove Villages located on approximately 4,600 acres at the northwest corner of Collier County on the border of Lee and Hendry counties. These two master planned developments are expected to comply with the County’s 1,500- acre cap for Villages, and be accompanied by approximately 7,000 acres of permanent conservation areas. The plan for both villages is to feature approximately 9,000 homes, including approximately 750 affordable housing units total for essential workers, and approximately 480,000 square feet of commercial space offering retail, dining, office, and medical uses. The East Village includes an additional 100,000 square feet for indoor self-storage and a minimum of 45,020 square feet of civic uses, and the West Village may include similar additional uses depending on County requirements and future site planning. Alico launched its multi-year entitlement process for Corkscrew Grove Villages by submitting an application to Collier County for local approval for the first of the two villages, the East Village. The Company has also submitted permit applications to the South Florida Water Management District and the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers for both villages. In April 2026, Alico received final local entitlement approvals from the Collier County Board of County Commissioners for the East Village component of Corkscrew Grove Villages. The approved East Village Stewardship Receiving Area (SRA) covers approximately 1,446.59 acres and provides for up to 4,502 dwelling units, including 362 affordable housing units, and up to 238,606 square feet of retail and office uses. This advances the project toward obtaining the required federal permits from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, as well as the state permits from the South Florida Water Management District. Construction on the first village could begin in 2028 or 2029 if all approvals are granted. In June 2026, Alico acquired the remaining 49% ownership interest in Citree, a joint venture through which the Company held a 51% interest in approximately 1,200 acres of land in DeSoto County, for $2.0 million in cash, plus potential contingent consideration and the assumption of all of Citree’s approximately $3.3 million of outstanding debt. Following the transaction, Alico owns 100% of the entity and its underlying acreage. The Company believes this transaction simplifies its corporate structure and gives it full ownership and control over the future use of this property, consistent with its broader strategy of streamlining the business. Alico maintains a strong commitment to regional conservation, having transferred lands over the past 40 years that became part of the Corkscrew Regional Ecosystem Watershed (CREW), Tiger Creek Preserve and Okaloacoochee Slough Wildlife Management Area. In 2023, Alico sold more than 17,000 acres of land from central Hendry County, commonly referred to as Devil’s Garden, to the Florida Department of Environmental Protection as part of the Florida Forever program. Since Devil’s Garden was added to the Florida Forever Priority List in 2002, Alico has sold or entered easements to protect more than 46,800 acres within the project boundaries. Combined with approximately 7,000 acres expected to be placed in conservation as part of the Corkscrew Grove Villages proposal, these efforts support the implementation of the Florida Wildlife Corridor. The plan for Corkscrew Grove Villages aligns with the Collier Rural Land Stewardship Area (RLSA) program, an innovative, incentive-based approach to sustainable rural growth that has received national recognition. The villages will enhance public infrastructure and provide significant economic benefit to the region at no additional cost to taxpayers. articles.title: Alta Equipment Group Agrees to Acquire Jackson Group Peterbilt in Proposed Transformative Deal
articles.description: Proposed acquisition expected to create scaled dealership platform for essential equipment that powers the industrial economy Would add commercial truck vertical with premier Peterbilt dealership platform with 34 locations in the western U.S. Expected to enhance earnings quality and cash generation and support continued deleveraging Proposed strategic investment from Viking Global Investors expected to help finance acquisition and support company’s focus on lean operations and capital efficiency LIVONIA, Mich., Nov. 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Alta Equipment Group Inc. (NYSE: ALTG) ("Alta" or the "Company"), a leading integrated equipment dealership platform in North America, today announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Jackson Group Peterbilt ("JGP"), a full-service commercial truck dealership group with an expansive footprint in the western United States. Under the terms of the agreement, Alta has agreed to acquire JGP for an estimated enterprise value of approximately $399 million, representing approximately 6.3x LTM Adjusted EBITDA as of September 30, 2026, or approximately 5.7x LTM Adjusted EBITDA after giving effect to approximately $40 million of estimated tax benefits associated with the transaction. The proposed transaction would be financed with a combination of cash and Alta common stock. Upon completion, the acquisition is expected to broaden Alta’s integrated industrial equipment dealership platform to include commercial trucks, material handling and construction equipment with 119 locations across 22 U.S. states and three Canadian provinces. Alta expects the transaction to be accretive to its earnings and cash flow profile in the first 12 months following closing, and, on a pro forma basis, expects net leverage to decline from approximately 4.8x to 3.7x proforma as of September 30, 2026 to an expected 3.6x at year-end 2026. "This is a transformative opportunity for Alta to establish a coast-to-coast dealership platform and broaden our business across equipment categories, end markets and customers,” said Ryan Greenawalt, Chief Executive Officer of Alta. "We expect the addition of JGP’s premier commercial truck dealership platform to create a third scaled segment for Alta, enhance our recurring aftermarket mix, and strengthen our cash generation capacity. Together, we anticipate being positioned well for continued growth and greater resilience across market cycles.” JGP operates 34 dealerships, including 12 full-service locations and 19 parts and service locations, as well as multiple parts-only locations and body shops. The business supports more than 50,000 customers across freight, vocational, construction, waste, municipal and other essential applications. JGP generated approximately $906 million in revenue and $63.3 million in Adjusted EBITDA for the trailing 12 months ended September 30, 2026. In connection with the transaction, Alta has entered into an agreement providing for a $338.4 million strategic investment from entities managed by Viking Global Investors LP ("Viking”) with economic rights that are pari passu with Alta common stock. The investment, which is conditioned on the closing of the acquisition, will help fund the acquisition as well as support Alta’s focus on lean operations and capital efficiency. In connection with the closing of the financing, Matt Vaughan, President of Battelle Memorial Institute, and Jeff Figg, who spent nearly 20 years as an executive at Danaher Corporation, are expected to join Alta’s Board of Directors. The acquisition is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to approval by Alta’s stockholders of the issuance of securities in the transactions, receipt of required regulatory and other third-party approvals and satisfaction or waiver, as applicable, of other closing conditions. Proposed Acquisition Expected to Provide Strategic and Financial Benefits Would Create a Leading Dealership Platform. The proposed combination would bring together proven dealership platforms with a shared focus on delivering essential equipment, product support and uptime to customers. Would Add a Scaled Commercial Trucks Vertical. JGP’s Peterbilt dealership platform with OEM-protected territories is expected to add a new scaled dealership vertical for additional growth and broaden Alta’s equipment and end-market exposure. Expected to Support Growth Through Greater Scale and Diversification. On a combined basis giving effect to the acquisition, Alta and JGP generated approximately $2.7 billion in revenue and $226 million in Adjusted EBITDA for the trailing 12 months ended September 30, 2026. The proposed combination is expected to expand Alta’s geographic, equipment category and customer exposure. Expected to Improve Earnings Quality and Capital Efficiency. The combination is expected to grow Alta’s installed base and enhance its recurring aftermarket mix, increasing the contribution of aftermarket to gross profit to 59% and improving absorption from 77% to 89% on a proforma basis. JGP’s capital-efficient business model is expected to improve Alta’s return on invested capital. Expected to Strengthen Cash Generation and Support Deleveraging. The combination is expected to enhance cash generation and financial flexibility, supporting continued deleveraging towards the Company’s new leverage target of 2.0x - 3.0x Adjusted EBITDA, while preserving capacity for disciplined organic growth and M&A.Additional Transaction Details The transaction is expected to provide meaningful tax benefits, including the potential utilization of approximately $170 million in federal net operating losses, subject to applicable limitations and the availability of taxable income. Affiliates of Viking have agreed to invest $338.4 million in Alta’s new Series B Convertible Preferred Stock. The investment is priced at the 60-day volume-weighted average price of $6.33 per share of Alta common stock on an as-converted basis. The Series B shares will be non-voting and will have economic rights that are pari passu with Alta common stock and, as such, have no liquidation preference, preferred coupon or maturity date. Upon closing of the financing, Viking will have the right to designate two members of Alta’s board of directors and one non-voting board observer, as well as consent rights over certain significant corporate actions, in each case, subject to minimum ownership thresholds and the terms of the definitive documents. Viking’s aggregate voting power upon conversion of the Series B shares would be capped at 49.9% at all times. The credits were launched at COP31, the United Nations Climate Change Conference held in Antalya, Türkiye, from November 11 to 20, 2026. It is built to give institutions the auditability, risk mitigation and transparency they need to hold and trade tokenized real-world assets. On AQUAEChain, MindChain keeps the underlying environmental evidence separate from transaction records. Ecological data stays unchanged and fully traceable as each credit is issued, transferred or retired. This gives auditors a clear trail and removes the risk of the same credit being counted twice. AQUAE Labs’ credit issuance system on AQUAEChain, which links each credit to a verified ecological record, has a patent application pending in Singapore. ALCI measures seven areas of ecosystem performance: above-ground biomassoxygen productionwater purificationcoolingsoil water retentionliving soilbiodiversity These measurements inform a transparent valuation of the ecosystem services each credit represents. USA. By pairing robust, field-based ecological MRV with insurance coverage from Lloyd’s syndicate partners, AQUAE Labs is establishing a new standard of trust, transparency and bankability for non-carbon nature assets. At COP31, the MindWave team held technical infrastructure discussions and met with institutional partners about MindChain, alongside the AQUAE Labs team, which engaged with prospective corporate buyers, institutional investors and implementation partners. articles.title: Williams keeps December Fed hike in play as inflation seen above 2% until 2028
articles.description: Williams' remarks support pricing for a quarter-point hike in December and further tightening in 2027, which should keep front-end Treasury yields firm and give the US dollar some support. Energy features in his inflation story, and he calls the energy outlook uncertain, so any renewed rise in oil would add to the hawkish case. For equities, his message suggests the Fed will not step back from tightening just because stocks have been volatile, though the AI-led rally shows risk appetite can hold up under a hiking path. If December data come in hot, traders may start pricing a faster pace of increases next year. --- The big Monday news: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as President and CEO, effective immediately Williams sees growth as strong and the labour market as steady, and with inflation not back at target until 2028, he has no reason to take the Fed off its tightening path. Summary: New York Fed President John Williams says inflation is too high and the Fed still has work to do to return it to 2% He sees inflation ending 2026 at 3.5%, just above 2% next year and at target in 2028, with upside risks He says energy prices are a key driver and their outlook is uncertain; tariffs, conflicts and AI are lifting some goods prices but not spreading widely He forecasts 2.75% growth in 2026 and 2027 and sees unemployment easing from 4.1% to around 4% next year Williams will assess the data before the December 8-9 meeting; markets expect a quarter-point hike from the 3.75%-4.00% range The remarks came on a day of strong stock gains after Nvidia said it would reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO New York Federal Reserve President John Williams said on Monday that inflation remains too high and the US central bank still has work to do to bring it back to its 2% goal, leaving the door open to another rate increase when policymakers meet on December 8 and 9. In remarks prepared for an event at the University of Mount Saint Vincent in New York City, Williams said the Fed needs to act over time to return inflation to target in a timely way and keep it there. He added that he will keep weighing incoming data before deciding what the Fed should do at the December meeting, stopping short of committing to a move. His forecasts underline how long the job could take. Williams expects inflation to finish 2026 at 3.5%, slow to just above 2% next year and reach the target only in 2028. He described the risks to that path as tilted to the upside, pointing to energy prices as one of the main drivers of price pressure and saying their outlook is uncertain. Williams did offer some reassurance on the breadth of the problem. In his view, tariffs, geopolitical conflicts and the surge in artificial intelligence investment are lifting prices in certain categories of goods, but there is little sign these effects are feeding through into wider, more persistent inflation. He also said the impact of AI on the economy overall remains uncertain. On growth and jobs, his assessment was upbeat. Williams sees the economy as strong and resilient, forecasting growth of 2.75% in both 2026 and 2027, and described the labour market as stable. He expects the unemployment rate, currently 4.1%, to edge down to around 4% next year. Markets broadly expect the Fed to lift its policy rate by a quarter of a percentage point in December from the current 3.75% to 4.00% range, with further increases anticipated next year. The Fed last raised rates in September, and inflation has now run above target for more than five years, raising concern among officials that the public could lose faith in a return to 2%. The remarks landed on a day of sharp gains for stocks, after Nvidia said it was reinstating Jensen Huang as chief executive following a push from President Donald Trump. The rally highlighted how heavily markets lean on AI companies, and came after some observers had questioned whether recent equity losses might make the Fed hesitate. Williams' message suggests stock market swings are unlikely to knock the Fed off its focus on inflation. This article was written by Eamonn Sheridan at investinglive.com.

The updated MRE (Table 1) includes base-case, pit-constrained resources comprising 2,147 million tonnes averaging 0.25% Cu and 0.015% Mo (0.30% CuEq) of Measured and Indicated categories (M&I), and 971 million tonnes averaging 0.45% Cu and 0.044% Mo (0.60% CuEq) of Inferred category. This updated MRE includes 265 million tonnes averaging 0.38% Cu and 0.015% Mo (0.43% CuEq) that are pit-constrained and 706 million tonnes averaging 0.48% Cu and 0.055% Mo (0.66% CuEq) from underground resources at Porphyry Mountain. It also comprises a revision of the open pit base-case resource from the Spring 2026 MRE (see April 14, 2026 news release), justified by using a lower cut-off of 0.12% CuEq as a result of using higher long-term copper pricing (US$5.00/lb), as well as the addition of inferred underground resources from the Porphyry Mountain deposit. The overall resource outlines one of the largest undeveloped copper-molybdenum deposits in North America: 11.6 billion pounds (5.26 million tonnes) of contained copper and 712 million pounds of contained molybdenum in the M&I category, as well as potential for an additional 9.6 billionpounds (4.37 million tonnes) of contained copper and 943 million pounds of contained molybdenum in the Inferred category.
